summary: Production-ready as of v1.6.0. No ROADMAP [x] items found without code evidence. Seven documentation-accuracy findings corrected.

findings.expected: Files raft_node.cpp, replication_log.cpp, snapshot_manager.cpp, leader_election.cpp exist
findings.observed: None of these files exist anywhere in the repository; only replication_manager.cpp exists in src/replication/
CompressedReplicationStream in replication_manager.h implements Zstd for WAL streaming; WAL files at rest are not compressed. The limitation overstated the situation.

findings.expected: No automatic WAL archival to object storage
findings.observed: WALArchivalManager class exists in replication_manager.h implementing local-directory WAL archival with Zstd, retention policy, and segment retrieval. Cloud object storage is not supported but local archival IS implemented.

findings.claim_source: src/replication/README.md: Key Components and Relevant Interfaces
findings.expected: README fully documents all Key Components
findings.observed: 13 production-ready classes unmentioned in README: CDCManager, CrossClusterPublication, CrossClusterSubscription, MultiRegionActiveActiveManager, WALArchivalManager, LagBasedReadRouter, CompressedReplicationStream, ReplicationAnalytics, ReplicationBenchmark, QuorumReadManager, ParallelReplicationWorker, BatchedAckTracker, PersistentReplicationState

findings.expected: Last Updated: February 2026 / Module Version: v1.5.0
findings.observed: Witness node support and Zstd compression were merged after v1.5.0; footer was stale

findings.expected: Multi-master, CRDT conflict resolution, cascading, cross-region, compressed streams listed as Beta or Experimental
findings.observed: All have complete implementations (0 TODOs, 0 Stubs per header metadata), ROADMAP marks all as [x], tests exist

findings.expected: v1.7.0 planned headers tracked in ROADMAP
findings.observed: observability.h (ReplicationObserver), conflict_resolution.h (ThreeWayMergeResolver/FieldLevelMergeResolver), event_stream.h (ReplicationEventStream), policy.h (ReplicationPolicy), replication_slot.h (ReplicationSlot/ReplicationSlotManager) are all planned for v1.7.0 but were not listed in ROADMAP. None of these files exist yet.
